title: Multi Hot 5 Burn Wilds

sourceFacts: The official public page specifies three rows, five reels and five paylines. Wilds appear on reels 2–4, substitute in left-to-right wins, and expand vertically when used by a winning combination. The total win receives a 1x–5x multiplier.
unresolved: Full provider paytable, probabilities and repeated expansion order remain unverified.
The independent model expands the wild columns used by initial winning lines, then evaluates again. X2 uses independently fair colors, a pre-spin hold control and an independent three-attempt limit.

publishedHelp.wildExpansion: Wild expands vertically when part of a winning line

limitations: The visible Spin ID and settled screenshot support one completed round; no current-day history row was captured before the parent closed the demo tabs.
The main stage visibly places the multiplier above the reels, while help text refers to a left reel; the visual placement correction remains pending in local layout/rendering.
No actual winning Wild expansion or X2 gamble was observed.
Published DMO stake limits are not ETB account configuration.
Low-fruit paytable values were read in the visible rules but the surviving image crops that section; they are omitted from the structured confirmed paytable.
